title: Cloud production quality evidence kits — the seven harness-backed gates for production-100
purpose: Elaborates the seven quality-evidence kits referenced in masterplan production_100_bar.quality_evidence_kits into actionable target definitions: per kit a harness, scenarios/drills, evidence format, and the production-100 gate it feeds. Each kit produces MEASURED evidence (not a document) before any maturity claim. Honest non-claim: target spec; the harnesses, drills, and evidence pipelines are not implemented here.
maturity_ladder_binding: Each kit's evidence is preserved per the L0->L7 ladder; a level cannot be claimed without its kits green; no marketing claim before evidence.

kits.harness: synthetic overload generator + per-tenant request-cost classifier
kits.evidence: shed-rate vs offered-load curve; fairness index across tenants under overload; no cascading failure
correlated-impact probability matrix; measured blast-radius containment; noisy-neighbor isolation drill
data-flow map; DSR round-trip proofs (delete/export within SLA); residency enforcement test

kits.harness: one-cell canary orchestrator + automated metric evaluator + PRR template
kits.evidence: canary eval reports; PRR sign-offs; rollback drill evidence
FOCUS export validated against schema; cost attribution reconciles to invoices

kits.harness: admission policy test set (Kubewarden, default; Kyverno adapter)
controls: privileged workloads require owner + expiry + mitigation
kits.evidence: admission-policy test results; privileged-exception register with expiries

kits.harness: abuse/fraud/DDoS scenario drills + ingress protection test
kits.evidence: drill results; ingress protection thresholds; suspension/appeals round-trip

non_claims: Target spec only — defines the kits; does NOT implement harnesses, drills, evidence pipelines, or produce any measured evidence.
No production/security/cost/SLO maturity claim; every kit's green status stays blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
